assessment.summary: A field trial in three villages in Nigeria comparing the efficacy of PermaNet 3.0, PermaNet 2.0, and untreated nets. The study confirms the presence of kdr and metabolic resistance in local Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations and evaluates the impact of the nets on entomological indices.
